title: The shared hover tokens are defined in :root

when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` that sets a pointer cursor.
then: Expects a `:hover` rule naming the same class, and expects the shared hover tokens to be defined.

title: The stage fills the window behind panels floating inset and frosted, each panel edge the one ResizeHandle
when: Reads the stylesheet and the source, and opens a use case on the Graph stage with the side bar shown.
then: Expects the shell, inset, radius and floating surface and shadow tokens; no separator drawn outside ResizeHandle; exactly three splitters, the navigation's, the wiki card's and the side bar's, each a resize handle; the Graph stage filling the window behind and inside no panel; and the nav, wiki card, page bar, header strip and side bar each floating on its side.
notes: Also: `app/stability/panes.spec.ts`, which measures the panels and the stage in a browser.

title: On a record page the nav, the wiki card and the side bar each resize by one handle at their edge
then: Expects the shell, gap and radius tokens, no separator drawn outside ResizeHandle, and on a record with the wiki and graph open the navigation, the gap between the panes and the side bar as resize handles beside panels.
notes: Also: `app/stability/panes.spec.ts`, which measures the panels and the stage in a browser.

title: One page bar holds the tabs, the one Stage switch, the wiki card toggle and the side bar toggle, and a stage's own tools float outside it
when: Opens a use case on the Graph and ERD stages, and on the Graph stage on a phone.
then: Expects one page bar, inside no panel or stage, holding the tab strip at its left (on a phone the Open pages button instead), and at its right the one Stage group of `aria-pressed` buttons, one pressed, then the wiki card toggle and the side bar toggle last; no pane or pane header anywhere; the stage's own tools inside the stage, never in the page bar; the page's h1 in the header strip; and the page bar and header strip of fixed height.

title: On a use case, wide or on a phone, the page bar holds the page's controls and no stage tool
when: Opens a record alone, with the wiki and graph, and with both on a phone.
then: Expects one page bar, outside every pane and the side bar, holding the tab strip at its left (on a phone, the Open pages button instead), and at its right the one "View" group of `aria-pressed` toggles, one pressed per shown pane, with the side bar toggle last. On a wide screen each pane is a panel whose first child is its slim header: a non-interactive label naming its view, and only its close button (when more than one pane is open) and its full screen button, all icon buttons, with no tabs or groups in it. On a phone one pane shows, with no header. The title sits in the leftmost pane, and the stylesheet gives the page bar and the pane headers fixed heights.

title: Motion is shared and optional: every transition and animation uses the motion or hover tokens and is turned off under reduced motion
when: Reads every style rule in `app/src/styles.css` that sets a transition or animation.
then: Expects its times and easing to come from `--motion-speed`, `--motion-ease` or `--hover-speed`, and each such selector to be turned off by a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` rule or to apply only under `no-preference`. Expects the tokens to be defined, and code that animates frame by frame to take its timing from `readMotion()`, which reads them and checks `prefers-reduced-motion`.

title: The glide follows the shared easing: CSS's ease, read from the motion tokens
then: Checks the easing curve against CSS's ease walked finely, a pan halfway through the time most of the way there, and the motion tokens parsed as the stylesheet writes them.

title: The row link's ::after stretches over its row, with the row's other controls above it
when: Renders a domain page and a record page.
then: Expects every row of every `record-list` (each tree item's own row, and each plain row) that holds a record link to have exactly one `row-link`, a real link to a record's page. Reads `app/src/styles.css` and expects the `row-link` `::after` to be absolute with `inset: 0`, the rows to be `position: relative`, the row's other controls to sit above it with a `z-index`, and the link to give the row a hover tint and a focus ring.

title: Every record row on the domain and record pages has exactly one row link to its record
when: Renders a domain page and a record page.
then: Expects every row of every `record-list` (each tree item's own row, and each plain row) that holds a record link to have exactly one `row-link`, a real link to a record's page. Reads `app/src/styles.css` and expects the `row-link` `::after` to be absolute with `inset: 0`, the rows to be `position: relative`, the row's other controls to sit above it with a `z-index`, and the link to give the row a hover tint and a focus ring.

then: Expects the same tabs in order with the same preview and active tab, the address `?stage=graph`, the Graph stage drawn, and the second tab, activated, back on the Trace stage.

title: In the Tree, Nested and Voronoi layouts, at every domain, stage and folder of every product, at depths 1 to 3 in two frames, siblings share one size and text scale and every drawn box shows its name

title: Each label line is placed in map units at its face's size times its box's text scale, inside its box, and drawn at that size times the zoom

On the page, expects each drawn line's font on screen to be its map size times the zoom, and a line under `TEXT_BAR_PX` drawn as a bar. Expects the canvas's measure to read each width once at its face's font, and the plain measure to be the same every time.
